task: Deliver readiness items Phase 2 'Large-scale PV/PVC scalability test' and Phase 5 'Scalability & performance benchmark' from issue #81: add synthetic PV event-storm scalability benchmark harness (100-2000 PVs), make bench target, and CI benchmark step, and fix pre-existing timing flake in TestWatchPVsEventStormAtScale under high load.

events.summary: Readiness items Phase 2 'Large-scale PV/PVC scalability test' and Phase 5 'Scalability & performance benchmark' from issue #81: add BenchmarkWatchPVsEventStorm (100-2000 PVs), make bench target, and CI benchmark step, while fixing pre-existing timing flake in TestWatchPVsEventStormAtScale via waitForProgress stall detection in internal/agent/helpers_test.go. Not touched: quota logic, argv construction, RBAC, docs, or other packages.

On 2026-11-08 make test in a merge-train dry run failed TestWatchPVsEventStormAtScale with 'condition not met within 10s' (watch_storm_test.go:116) at load average ~29.7; isolated go test -count=3 -run 'TestWatchPVsEventStormAtScale$' failed on origin/main 6ef10fb as well, so it is a pre-existing timing flake (fixed 10s total deadline vs per-PV fsync cost).
Replace fixed deadline with waitForProgress (internal/agent/helpers_test.go) — fail only when progress stalls 10s, 120s absolute cap; all original correctness assertions kept.
go test -count=1 -run TestWatchPVsEventStormAtScale -v ./internal/agent/ PASS 20.36s at load avg ~37; go test -count=1 ./internal/agent/ ok 22.432s; gofmt -l empty; make vet clean.
events.scope: internal/agent package test suite under high load with stubbed quota runner; verifies progress-based stall detection resolves timing flake without altering correctness assertions.

events.summary: make bench ran BenchmarkWatchPVsEventStorm pvs=100/500/1000/2000 x3 (count=3) on macOS arm64, load avg 36.78, all correctness assertions held; ms/pv range 21.28-54.00; reconciles/op 101-102 (100), 500-502 (500), 1002 (1000), 2002 (2000). Stubbed quota.CommandRunner: measures controller pipeline incl. real projects/projid fsync, NOT kernel enforcement.
events.scope: Controller pipeline scalability across 100-2000 PVs using stubbed quota.CommandRunner; measures controller pipeline throughput and fsync cost, not kernel enforcement.
